ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a BJT common-emitter amplifier circuit. In the collector branch there is a resistor Rc connected to Vcc, the output Vo is taken from the collector node, and the direction of the output/collector current Io is also marked in the figure. The input signal Vs is applied to the base through the source resistor Rs. The emitter branch has a resistor RE connected to ground, and RE has no bypass capacitor. Then reason: The emitter current is approximately related to the collector/output current, and when it flows through RE, it produces at the emitter a voltage proportional to this current. The actual input quantity of the transistor is the base-emitter voltage Vbe, so the feedback voltage on the emitter will be opposite to the input signal, equivalently being series mixing at the input end. Since the feedback signal is obtained by sampling the output current/emitter current, it is current sampling; since it is connected in series to the input end by changing Vbe, it is series mixing. Therefore this feedback topology is current-series feedback.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: note that the BJT has Rc in the collector branch, Vo at the collector, and RE in the emitter branch without a bypass capacitor. Then infer the feedback path: output/emitter current flows through RE, producing a voltage at the emitter proportional to that current. This voltage is fed back in opposition to the base input because the actual transistor input is the base-emitter voltage. Therefore the output is sampled as current and the feedback is mixed in series at the input, so the topology is current series feedback.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个BJT共射极放大电路。集电极支路有电阻 Rc 接到 Vcc，输出 Vo 从集电极节点取出，图中还标有输出/集电极电流 Io 的方向。输入信号 Vs 通过源电阻 Rs 加到基极。发射极支路接有电阻 RE 到地，并且 RE 没有旁路电容。
再推理：发射极电流与集电极/输出电流近似相关，流过 RE 时在发射极产生一个与该电流成比例的电压。晶体管的实际输入量是基极-发射极电压 Vbe，因此发射极上的反馈电压会与输入信号相反，等效为在输入端串联混合。由于反馈信号由输出电流/发射极电流取样得到，所以是电流取样；由于它以改变 Vbe 的方式串联到输入端，所以是串联混合。因此该反馈拓扑为电流串联反馈。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This uses the standard feedback-topology test: identify the sampled output variable and the input mixing connection directly from the circuit structure. It is the primary and essentially unique route for this diagram.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the circuit as a BJT common-emitter amplifier with collector resistor Rc to Vcc, output Vo/Io taken at the collector, an unbypassed emitter resistor RE to ground, and the signal source Vs with Rs applied to the base while the emitter is not AC-grounded.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt only to know that the requested quantity is the feedback topology and that the omitted base-bias network should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use feedback classification rules: if the feedback element senses a current proportional to output current, it is current sampling; if the feedback voltage is inserted in series with the input so that the controlling signal is vbe = vin − vf, it is series mixing. An unbypassed emitter resistor in a CE amplifier provides emitter degeneration: emitter/collector current through RE creates a feedback voltage opposing the input.

Therefore this feedback topology is current-series feedback.
